topic: The Magic of Text-to-Image AI: From Concepts to Pixels
target_audience: University students with a basic background in linear algebra and probability

sections.title: Introduction: The Bridge between Language and Vision
lecture_lines: AI translates language into visual pixel arrays.
We use CLIP to understand text meanings.
Diffusion models act as creative artists.

sections.title: CLIP: The Multimodal Semantic Compass
lecture_lines: CLIP maps text and images together.
Concepts exist in a shared vector space.
Related items cluster closely in this space.

sections.title: The Mathematics of Diffusion: Adding and Subtracting Noise
lecture_lines: The forward process adds Gaussian noise.
Pure static replaces the original image.
The reverse process iteratively removes noise.
Markov chains guide the image reconstruction.
animations: Show clear image then add noise pixels, color #808080.
Increase noise until pure static, color #FFFFFF.
Display math formula x_t = sqrt(1-beta)*x_0 + sqrt(beta)*epsilon, color #00FF00.

sections.title: The Denoising Engine: Integrating CLIP Guidance
lecture_lines: The denoiser predicts noise to subtract.
CLIP vectors steer the generation process.
We maximize similarity to the prompt.
This creates a targeted visual output.
Styles are refined through guided diffusion.
animations: Display noisy image and CLIP, color #FF0000 and #00FFFF.
Show guidance vector pointing to noise, color #0000FF.

sections.title: Summary & Future Outlook
lecture_lines: CLIP and Diffusion power modern AI.
This bridge transforms ideas into art.
animations: Connect icons with pulsing green lines, color #00FF00.
Fade out with "Future: Unified Generative AI" text, color #FFD700.
